TipText: Building a perimeter around your base can help shield you from mobs at night
If you find yourself stuck, check what quests you have available in your MAT
Read the quests!
Check your roof, spiders can climb up it in the night
You can connect the water and lava on the back of the ship together to make a cobblestone generator
Seeds for most crops can be found in structures or dropped from sifting dirt
The temperature is hottest during the middle of the day, make sure to stay away from heat sources during this time
The temperature is coolest during the middle of the night. If you can protect yourself from hostiles, it would be an ideal time to work outside
You can cool down by standing in the shade
The environment is colder deeper underground
It's important to maintain a balanced diet to avoid negative effects. See your nutritional information by clicking the Diet button in your inventory.
If you eat enough fruits, you will be granted increased health regeneration speed
If you eat enough grains, you will be granted increased movement, mining, and attack speed
If you eat enough proteins, you will be granted increased attack damage
If you eat enough vegetables, you will be granted increased damage resistance and knockback resistance
Not eating enough fruits will stop natural regeneration
Not eating enough grains will decrease movement, mining, and attack speed
Not eating enough proteins will decrease attack damage
Not eating enough vegetables will increase damage taken
Eating lots of sugar will make you faster, but too much will cause weakness and hunger
Acceptable water is usually safe to drink, but has a 5% chance of giving hunger
A camel pack will automatically drink water for you
Drinking lava from a camel pack will quickly kill you (why would anyone do that?)
Campfires can be used to purify four water bottles at once
Compost leaves instead of saplings to maximize how much dirt and water you get per tree
If you break logs into sawdust, you can compost it for more dirt or water
A stillsuit will regulate body temperature and significantly reduce your water consumption
Crooks can break leaves for increased sapling drop rates and silk worms
Using a crook on oak leaves will give more drops than other types of leaves
A crucible can melt stone into lava
Crucibles can be used to melt down ores or ore chunks
A crucible can melt organic material directly into water
Sifting can be automated using a Deployer from Create or with a Mechanical Sieve
Sifting crushed blackstone will drop nether ingredients, with extra chances of gold or cobalt
Sifting crushed deepslate will drop common, rare, and very rare ore chunks, plus redstone, lapis, and gemstones
Sifting crushed end stone will drop end ingredients
Sifting crushed netherrack will drop nether ingredients, with extra chances of crimson and warped items
Sifting dirt will drop pebbles and random seeds
Sifting dust will drop common ore chunks, plus redstone, bone meal, and pebbles
Sifting gravel will drop common, uncommon, and rare ore chunks, plus flint, coal, redstone, and diamonds
Sifting moss will drop random flowers
When placed next to each other, up to nine sieves can be sifted at once
Sifting podzol will drop slime and random saplings
Sifting sand will drop uncommon ore chunks, plus quartz, and certus quartz
Sifting soul sand will drop nether ingredients, with extra chances of quartz
Upgrade your mesh to get higher yields from sifting
Building gadgets can be used to place or replace large amounts of blocks at once
An Exchanging Gadget can replace a wall of dust with solid blocks, allowing it to be mined without affecting blocks above it
End stone can be made from glowstone in a barrel of lava, or automated in an extruder with resonant ender
Netherrack can be made from redstone in a barrel of lava, or automated in an extruder with destabilized redstone
Endermen can teleport fast enough to dodge arrows, but not fast enough to dodge bullets
Cobalt can be found plentifully in the Foundry structure
Debris and netherite can be found in the Foundry structure
Plastic scraps can be found in structures and melted into plastic
Paste can replace slime balls in most recipes
JEI can show you what loot is found in structure chests
You can make a rover to navigate the wastes easier
You can find useful scraps by looking through the piles of trash found in structures
Just because you can't see a spawner doesn't mean it isn't there
Mob spawn eggs can be crafted in a dissolution chamber
Redstone dust can be converted directly into energy in any Mekanism machine
Bone tool parts can be made from bone meal
Once you have a foundry, more seared stone can be made by melting cobblestone (does not work in a Smeltery)
Ores give higher yields in a smeltery, and even higher yields in a Foundry
You can swap the parts of a tool using a tinker station or tinker's anvil
